title: The Penalty — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Twelve yards. One man with the ball.
One man with no instructions except to stop it.
And eighty thousand people who have already decided.

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Il portiere si tuffa prima del tiro [The goalkeeper dives before the kick]
Ottanta per cento delle volte indovina male [Eighty percent of the time he guesses wrong]
Il tiratore lo sa [The kicker knows this]
Il portiere sa che il tiratore lo sa [The goalkeeper knows the kicker knows this]
La folla non sa nulla di questo [The crowd knows none of this]
E urla comunque [And screams anyway]

[Chorus — English]
The penalty is the loneliest moment in football
One decision, one direction
The moment it leaves the boot — nothing can bring it back

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas sagte — der Elfmeter sagt dir alles über eine Person [Chas said — the penalty tells you everything about a person]
Nicht wer sie sind wenn sie treffen [Not who they are when they score]
Sondern wer sie sind wenn sie antreten und wissen dass sie vielleicht nicht treffen [Who they are when they step up knowing they might not]
Das ist der Test [That's the test]
Zwölf Yards ist ein sehr langer Weg wenn die ganze Welt zuschaut [Twelve yards is a very long walk when the whole world is watching]

[Verse 3 — English]
The keeper already knows where it's going
The kicker just hasn't told himself yet

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The penalty
Il rigore [The penalty]
Der Elfmeter [The penalty]
That's my boy
